newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL HELD TO GOALLESS DRAW BY STRUGGLING COMPOSTELA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL HELD TO GOALLESS DRAW BY STRUGGLING COMPOSTELA.

text.p: Spanish league leaders Real Madrid unexpectedly boosted the title hopes of second-placed Barcelona on Monday after being held to a goalless draw at home by struggling Compostela.
The result leaves Real seven points ahead of Barcelona and a further two in front of Real Betis with 10 games left to play. Barcelona thrashed Sporting Gijon 4-0 on Sunday.

Real striker Predrag Mijatovic missed several clear chances before the break but there were also opportunities for Compostela who were unlucky not to be awarded a second-half penalty after Fernando Hierro brought down Lyuboslav Penev.
In the dying minutes a back-heel from Real's Raul Gonzalez hit the post and trickled along the line before being cleared by a Compostela defender.
